verdict.rationale: Invoicing is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence never documents invoices or automatic payment reminders. What it does show is related but different: hosted checkout pages, shareable payment links, and subscription billing with automatic retries of rejected payments. None of these is an invoice, and retries are not reminders, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
